Reasoning: The plate area A=1, and the liquid dielectric constant K=2. The liquid surface descends with speed V, so the liquid thickness at time t is h(t)=d/3−Vt. The electric-field direction is perpendicular to the plates, so the space between the plates can be regarded as two layers of media in series along the electric-field direction: a liquid layer of thickness h(t) and an air layer of thickness d−h(t). The equivalent capacitance satisfies 1/C(t)=h(t)/(Kε0A)+(d−h(t))/(ε0A). Substituting A=1 and K=2 gives 1/C(t)=h(t)/(2ε0)+(d−h(t))/ε0=(d−h(t)/2)/ε0. Thus C(t)=ε0/(d−h(t)/2)=2ε0/(2d−h(t)).
